checks.source_text: WhatsApp reminders were sent only to borrowers who had consented to WhatsApp communication
checks.test: Every WhatsApp message has a WhatsApp consent captured before it and not opted out at that time
assumptions: Consent is held per borrower; an opt-out ends consent until a new consent is captured

checks.test: Every WhatsApp message uses a WhatsApp template approved on or before the send date

checks.source_text: Collection calls respected the permitted calling hours
checks.test: Every voice attempt falls inside the D12 calling window in borrower local time
assumptions: Every attempt counts, connected or not

checks.test: Unique voice attempts per account within D12 daily and weekly caps
assumptions: Weeks run Monday-Sunday; only attempts inside the audit period are counted

checks.source_text: All calls were made by recovery agents holding a valid certification
checks.test: The calling collector held a certificate valid on the call date
